rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line. **C7 Complete edges.** Caller and callee are never empty. The line is the line of the callee's name, per the ID-format rules.
notes: C has no method chains, but C7 fixes every edge's line as the line of the callee's name. A call whose arguments span lines 14-17 is reported per callee name; 'second' on line 18 with its argument list '(r)' on line 19 is reported on line 18, where the name is.
